name: Financial Machine Learning
description: Apply machine learning to markets: labels, features, position sizing and honest evaluation.

requires.why: Purges overlapping labels and adds an embargo when time-ordered folds meet horizon labels.
Reads classifier probabilities and thresholds to decide when to act on a primary signal.

lessonNames.l9-probability-to-position: From a probability to a position

lessonObjectives.l1-fixed-horizon: Label returns over a fixed horizon and find its weaknesses.
lessonObjectives.l2-triple-barrier: Label trades by a profit target, a stop loss and a time limit.
lessonObjectives.l3-meta-labelling: Use meta-labelling to decide when to act on a primary signal.
lessonObjectives.l4-overlapping-labels: Weight samples by how unique their labels are.
lessonObjectives.l6-fractional-differencing: Apply fractional differencing and choose its order.
lessonObjectives.l8-hidden-look-ahead: Find look-ahead hidden in a feature pipeline.
lessonObjectives.l9-probability-to-position: Turn predicted probabilities into position sizes.
lessonObjectives.l10-costs-eat-edges: Subtract trading costs and see which signals survive.
lessonObjectives.l11-deflated-sharpe: Deflate a Sharpe ratio for the number of trials behind it.
lessonObjectives.l12-end-to-end: Plan the 2.1 exit project with time-ordered validation from the start.
